data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'fadha', which means 'to bring forth', 'to give', 'to make known'. The name Fadia symbolizes the one who gives, enlightens, and brings prosperity. The name Fadia carries the meaning “Lady, Noble One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadia usually hope their child will grow to embody lady, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
